titleEn: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Vancouver? Real Timelines from 25 Projects
titleZh: 温哥华卫生间翻新需要多久？25个真实项目工期数据（2026）
contentEn:
On average, a standard bathroom renovation in Vancouver takes 2 to 3 weeks for a simple refresh — new shower, vanity, and tile — and extends to 9 to 11 weeks for a full gut renovation involving structural changes or permit work. Reno Stars has tracked actual timelines across 25 completed bathroom projects in Metro Vancouver, and the data shows a clear pattern: scope drives duration far more than location.

Whether you are renovating a condo in Richmond, a townhouse in Surrey, or a detached house in North Vancouver, the same phases apply in the same order. What changes is how long each phase takes and whether any phase requires a City of Vancouver building permit.

How Long Does a Standard Bathroom Renovation Take?

A standard bathroom renovation — defined as replacing fixtures, retiling, installing a new vanity, and updating plumbing finishes — consistently takes 2 to 4 weeks across all property types in the Vancouver area. Data from 25 Reno Stars bathroom projects confirms this range regardless of city: a standard shower conversion in a Coquitlam condo took 3 to 4 weeks, while an identical scope in a Burnaby house took the same 3 to 4 weeks.

Breaking this down by phase:

  • Demolition and subfloor preparation: 3 to 5 days
  • Plumbing rough-in (if layout unchanged): 2 to 3 days
  • Electrical updates: 1 to 2 days
  • Tile and waterproofing: 4 to 7 days
  • Vanity, fixtures, and finishing: 3 to 5 days

Total: 2 to 3 weeks for a straightforward replacement. Add 3 to 5 days for any unexpected subfloor repairs.

How Long Does a Full Gut Bathroom Renovation Take?

A full gut renovation — where the bathroom is stripped to the studs and the layout is reconfigured — takes 4 to 8 weeks in most Vancouver homes. The additional time comes from plumbing relocation, which requires a City of Vancouver permit in most cases, and potential structural work if walls are being moved or removed.

The longest project in the Reno Stars dataset was a two-bathroom renovation in West Vancouver that involved converting one bathroom into two and custom cabinetry throughout: 9 to 11 weeks total. This is the outlier, not the norm. A typical dual-bathroom renovation with layout changes runs 6 to 8 weeks.

Bathroom Renovation Timeline by Property Type

Property type affects timeline primarily through access constraints and building permit requirements. Condo renovations in strata buildings require Strata approval before work begins, adding 2 to 4 weeks to the pre-construction phase. Townhouse renovations typically proceed without Strata complications unless structural changes are involved.

Condo (Richmond, Coquitlam)Standard refresh3–4 weeksStrata approval required; no City permit for fixture swaps
Townhouse (Surrey, Delta)Custom features, dual vanity4–7 weeksNo Strata for fixture changes; layout moves may need permit
Detached House (North Van, West Van, Burnaby)Full gut, curbless shower, luxury finishes4–8 weeksPermit required for plumbing relocation; 2–4 week City of Vancouver permit timeline
Detached House (complex)Structural changes, two-into-one bathroom8–11 weeksBuilding permit required; structural engineer may be needed

What Homeowners in Vancouver Should Budget For

Beyond duration, the cost data from the same 25 projects provides a complete picture for Vancouver homeowners planning a bathroom renovation in 2026:

  • Budget refresh (powder room, single fixture swap): $3,500 – $18,000 | Timeline: 2–3 weeks
  • Standard renovation (new shower, vanity, tile): $14,000 – $26,000 | Timeline: 3–5 weeks
  • Mid-range renovation (dual vanity, custom tile, upgraded fixtures): $22,000 – $35,000 | Timeline: 4–7 weeks
  • Luxury renovation (curbless shower, custom cabinetry, high-end fixtures): $28,000 – $45,000 | Timeline: 5–8 weeks
  • Complex two-bathroom structural renovation: $57,000 – $60,000 | Timeline: 9–11 weeks

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, or Surrey? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars with real project timelines and transparent pricing.

What the Longest Delays Are in Vancouver Bathroom Renovations

The most common source of timeline slippage in Vancouver bathroom renovations is not City permits — it is material lead times. Specialty tile, imported fixtures, and custom glass hardware routinely take 3 to 6 weeks to arrive after order confirmation. Reno Stars builds material procurement into every project schedule from day one, but homeowners who choose specialty items should expect to add 3 to 6 weeks to the overall timeline.

The second most common delay is strata approval in condo buildings. The approval process alone can take 2 to 4 weeks, and strata boards in Vancouver typically meet monthly. Reno Stars handles all strata documentation as part of the project management service, but homeowners should initiate the strata application before signing any renovation contract.

Third is unexpected subfloor or plumbing discovery. In older Vancouver homes — particularly in Kerrisdale, Kitsilano, and Shaughnessy — original subfloors often require replacement before new tile can be installed. This adds 3 to 5 days and a modest cost premium, typically $800 – $2,500 depending on scope.

How to Plan Your Bathroom Renovation Timeline in Vancouver

For a Vancouver homeowner starting the planning process in 2026, the realistic end-to-end timeline from first consultation to final walkthrough looks like this:

  • Consultation and quote: 1–2 weeks
  • Design selection (tile, fixtures, vanity): 2–3 weeks (can overlap with strata approval)
  • Strata or permit application: 2–4 weeks (condos only)
  • Construction: 2–11 weeks depending on scope
  • Final inspection and punch list: 3–5 days

Total: 7 to 18 weeks for a complete bathroom renovation in Vancouver from decision to delivery. The 18-week figure applies only to complex structural renovations; the typical range for a standard-to-mid-range project is 8 to 12 weeks.

How long does a small bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A small or powder room renovation in Vancouver — replacing a toilet, vanity, and light fixture — typically takes 2 to 3 weeks. Reno Stars completed a powder room renovation in Richmond for $3,500–$4,000 in this timeframe.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Vancouver?

For fixture swaps, repainting, and retiling without layout changes, no City of Vancouver permit is required. A permit is required when moving plumbing fixtures — this means relocating a toilet, shower, or sink requires a building permit from the City of Vancouver, with a typical processing time of 2 to 4 weeks.

How long does a condo bathroom renovation take with strata approval?

Strata approval for a condo bathroom renovation in Vancouver typically takes 2 to 4 weeks, depending on the strata board meeting schedule. Construction then takes 3 to 4 weeks for a standard renovation, making the total timeline approximately 5 to 8 weeks from initial application to completion.

What is the longest phase in a Vancouver bathroom renovation?

Material lead time is often the longest phase in a Vancouver bathroom renovation in 2026, particularly for specialty tile, imported fixtures, and custom glass. Homeowners should budget 3 to 6 weeks for material delivery after order confirmation, in addition to the 2 to 8 weeks of construction time.

Can a bathroom renovation be done in one week in Vancouver?

A cosmetic-only refresh — repainting, swapping a vanity, and replacing a toilet — can theoretically be completed in 5 to 7 days. However, scheduling trades and material delivery typically extends this to 2 to 3 weeks even for the simplest scope in the Vancouver market.
contentZh:
温哥华标准卫生间翻新的平均工期为2至3周（仅更换洁具、墙砖和洗手台），而全面拆旧重建或涉及管道移位的工程则需4至8周。Reno Stars整理了在大温哥华地区完成的25个卫生间项目的实际工期数据，显示出明确的规律：工程范围对工期的影响远大于地理位置。

无论是在列治文的公寓、素里的联排别墅，还是北温的独立屋，卫生间翻新的各个阶段都按相同顺序进行。真正影响工期的是每个阶段的实际时长，以及是否需要申请温哥华市建筑许可证。

温哥华标准卫生间翻新需要多久？

标准卫生间翻新（定义为更换洁具、重新贴砖、安装新洗手台并更新管道配件）在温哥华地区各个物业类型的工期通常为2至4周。本拿比公寓的简单淋浴间改造和高贵林公寓的同等工程均耗时3至4周，列治文独立屋的工程亦不例外。

各阶段细分：

  • 拆除及地面基层处理：3至5天
  • 管道预装（布局不变更情况下）：2至3天
  • 电路更新：1至2天
  • 贴砖及防水处理：4至7天
  • 洗手台、洁具及收尾工作：3至5天

合计：简单更换工程2至3周完成。如发现地面基层需修复，另加3至5天。

温哥华全面拆旧重建卫生间需要多久？

全面拆旧重建（将卫生间剥离至结构层并重新规划布局）在大温大多数住宅中需4至8周。额外时间主要来自管道移位（大多数情况需申请温哥华市建筑许可证）以及可能涉及的结构工程。

Reno Stars数据集中工期最长的项目是西温一处将一间卫生间改建成两间的工程，包含定制橱柜：总工期9至11周。这是极端个案，非常规情况。典型的双卫生间布局改造工程工期为6至8周。

按物业类型划分的卫生间翻新工期

物业类型主要通过进入限制和建筑许可证要求影响工期。温哥华柏文大厦翻新需在工程开始前获得业主法团（Strata）审批，额外增加施工前期2至4周时间。联排别墅翻新通常不受Strata审批限制（结构变更除外）。

物业类型典型工程范围工期区间许可证说明
公寓（列治文、高贵林）标准翻新3–4周需Strata审批；仅更换洁具无需市级许可证
联排别墅（素里、Delta）定制功能、双洗手台4–7周更换洁具无需Strata；布局变更可能需许可证
独立屋（北温、西温、本拿比）全面拆旧、无障碍淋浴间、豪华装修4–8周管道移位需许可证；温哥华市审批周期2–4周
独立屋（复杂工程）结构变更、一间改两间卫生间8–11周需建筑许可证；可能需要结构工程师参与

温哥华业主的装修预算与工期规划

除工期外，同一批25个项目的成本数据为温哥华业主2026年的卫生间翻新规划提供了完整参考：

  • 局部翻新（洗手间、单一洁具更换）：$3,500 – $18,000 | 工期：2–3周
  • 标准翻新（淋浴间、洗手台、墙砖）：$14,000 – $26,000 | 工期：3–5周
  • 中档翻新（双洗手台、定制瓷砖、高端配件）：$22,000 – $35,000 | 工期：4–7周
  • 豪华翻新（无障碍淋浴间、定制橱柜、高端洁具）：$28,000 – $45,000 | 工期：5–8周
  • 双卫生间结构改造工程：$57,000 – $60,000 | 工期：9–11周

计划在温哥华、列治文、本拿比或素里进行厨房、卫生间、全屋或商业装修？获取Reno Stars的免费、无义务报价，包含真实项目工期和透明定价。

温哥华卫生间翻新最常见的延误原因

温哥华卫生间翻新最常见的工期延误来源不是市政许可，而是材料到货周期。特殊瓷砖、进口洁具和定制玻璃配件在确认订单后通常需要3至6周才能到达。Reno Stars在每个项目工期表中都从第一天起就将材料采购纳入计划，但业主选择特殊产品时应预留额外的3至6周时间。

第二常见的延误是公寓楼的Strata审批。审批流程本身需要2至4周，温哥华的Strata委员会通常每月召开一次会议。Reno Stars作为项目管理服务的一部分处理所有Strata文件工作，但业主应在签署任何装修合同之前就启动Strata申请。

第三是意外发现的地面基层或管道问题。在温哥华的老旧住宅（尤其是Kerrisdale、Kitsilano和Shaughnessy地区），原有地面基层通常需要更换才能铺设新瓷砖。这将额外增加3至5天时间和$800至$2,500的预算，具体取决于工程范围。

如何规划温哥华卫生间翻新工期

对于2026年开始规划的温哥华业主，从首次咨询到最终验收的完整时间线如下：

  • 咨询和报价：1–2周
  • 设计选材（瓷砖、洁具、洗手台）：2–3周（可与Strata审批并行）
  • Strata或许可证申请：2–4周（仅限公寓）
  • 施工：按工程范围2–11周
  • 最终验收和整改清单：3–5天

合计：温哥华卫生间翻新从决策到交付完整工期为7至18周。18周的数字仅适用于复杂的结构改造工程；标准至中档项目的典型工期范围为8至12周。

温哥华小卫生间翻新需要多久？

温哥华的局部或洗手间翻新——更换马桶、洗手台和灯具——通常需要2至3周。Reno Stars在列治文完成的一个洗手间翻新工程（$3,500–$4,000）即在此时间范围内完成。

温哥华卫生间翻新需要许可证吗？

仅更换洁具、重新粉刷和在不改变布局的情况下重新贴砖无需申请温哥华市许可证。移动管道洁具则需要建筑许可证——这意味着重新安置马桶、淋浴间或洗手池需要向温哥华市申请建筑许可证，审批周期通常为2至4周。

含Strata审批的温哥华公寓卫生间翻新需要多久？

温哥华公寓卫生间翻新的Strata审批通常需要2至4周，具体取决于Strata委员会会议安排。施工则需3至4周（标准翻新），使总工期从最初申请到完工约为5至8周。

温哥华卫生间翻新中最耗时的阶段是什么？

材料到货周期往往是2026年温哥华卫生间翻新中最耗时的阶段，尤其是特殊瓷砖、进口洁具和定制玻璃配件。业主应在订单确认后预留3至6周的交货时间，外加2至8周的施工时间。

温哥华的卫生间翻新能否在一周内完成？

纯装饰性的局部翻新——重新粉刷、更换洗手台和马桶——理论上可以在5至7天内完成。然而，在温哥华市场，即使最简单的工程，预约工种和材料配送通常也会将时间延长至2至3周。
